description: This is a shell script designed for bug checking and reporting related to ath10k (wireless chipset) crashes on OpenWrt firmware. It collects system logs, crash data, and outputs reports for debugging.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects system info such as uname, os-release, dmesg, CPU info, meminfo, cmdline, and loaded modules, saving them into the bug report directory.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Prepares the crash report directory, archiving existing crash reports to maintain history.
